cards.title: Product & Strategy
cards.description: Defining product direction, MVP scope, and priorities across complex B2B systems.

items.label: MVP Definition
items.content: Defined MVP scope by turning fragmented ideas and disconnected modules into coherent end-to-end product flows.

items.label: Roadmap Planning
items.content: Built and maintained roadmaps that aligned business goals, product priorities, and delivery sequencing.

items.label: Backlog Prioritization
items.content: Turned requests, feedback, and technical constraints into clear execution priorities for delivery teams.

items.label: Stakeholder Management
items.content: Aligned leadership, product, and delivery stakeholders around priorities, trade-offs, and realistic expectations.

items.label: Release Strategy
items.content: Helped shape structured release thinking from beta readiness through launch preparation and version planning.

items.label: Product Scope Alignment
items.content: Connected business intent, user needs, and technical realities into product scope that teams could execute with clarity.

cards.title: Research & Analysis
cards.description: Using market insight, user feedback, and beta learning to support stronger product decisions.

items.label: Market Analysis
items.content: Used market signals and commercial context to support product positioning and decision-making.

items.label: Competitive Analysis
items.content: Reviewed competing solutions and market patterns to strengthen prioritization and product direction.

items.label: User Feedback
items.content: Translated customer, demo, and tester feedback into clearer product and UX decisions.

items.label: Beta Testing
items.content: Worked directly with beta users to identify friction points, validate flows, and improve launch readiness.

items.label: Pricing Strategy
items.content: Contributed to pricing and packaging thinking through market analysis and target-customer evaluation.

items.label: Customer Discovery
items.content: Helped identify potential customer segments and enterprise-fit opportunities relevant to the product.

cards.title: Delivery & Collaboration
cards.description: Turning product intent into aligned execution across teams, functions, and delivery constraints.

items.label: Requirements Gathering
items.content: Structured business, user, and product needs into inputs that teams could estimate, discuss, and build against.

items.label: Acceptance Criteria
items.content: Defined clear acceptance logic to align product goals, UX behavior, and implementation details.

items.label: UX Collaboration
items.content: Worked with design in Figma to review flows, clarify intent, and reduce ambiguity before development.

items.label: Product Documentation
items.content: Created documentation that improved handoff quality, shared understanding, and execution consistency.

items.label: Cross-Team Coordination
items.content: Coordinated work across distributed teams and functions to keep delivery moving through dependencies and change.

items.label: Agile Delivery
items.content: Supported structured agile delivery through backlog flow, team alignment, and realistic planning across evolving priorities.

cards.title: Tools & Technical Context
cards.description: Working comfortably across product, design, and technical tooling in platform and API-driven environments.

items.label: Figma
items.content: Used Figma to review flows, discuss UX decisions, and align implementation expectations with design intent.

items.label: Jira / Monday.com
items.content: Managed backlog structure, issue tracking, prioritization, and day-to-day delivery follow-up.

items.label: GitHub
items.content: Worked closely with repositories, pull requests, release visibility, and engineering collaboration.

items.label: Postman / Swagger / GitBook
items.content: Used API and documentation tools to understand system behavior and support functional clarification.

items.label: API-Driven Systems
items.content: Operated effectively in products where APIs, integrations, and backend logic were central to delivery.

items.label: WordPress / React Context
items.content: Brought practical context from WordPress-based platforms, frontend rebuilds, and modern web product environments.
